data.title: Warm Shores Draw Autumn Break Crowds to Aseer Waterfront in Al-Haridah
data.content:
Abha, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Aseer Waterfront in Al-Haridah is drawing large numbers of residents and visitors as the autumn break begins, with thousands heading to the warm, mild Red Sea coast to escape the cold, fog, and rain in the region's highlands.
    One of the region's leading winter destinations, the waterfront combines striking natural scenery with full facilities, including 200,000 square meters of green space popular with families from the mountain governorates, a 20-meter-wide seaside promenade used by walkers around the clock, about 200 sea-facing seating areas, cafés, recreational projects, and children's play areas.
    The Saudi Press Agency saw large numbers of families and young people relaxing on the lawns and seaside seating, many photographing the sunset over the horizon, while others swam, fished, took boat trips, dove, and explored coral reefs.
    The Aseer Region Municipality has stepped up field operations during the break to oversee cleaning and maintenance, manage heavy traffic, keep public facilities ready, and enforce marine safety standards, providing a safe and enjoyable experience in line with Saudi Vision 2030's goals to develop tourism and improve quality of life.
    -- SPA
